name: AI insights write-back
description: CLM with IAM: when Agreement Manager's AI has read a document (smart rule 'AI insights write-back', event Document Processed for AI Insights, in /Contracts), this workflow reads what the AI found (Use AI Data Insights) and what CLM already holds (Find Document into an XML variable, which carries every attribute group, CLM Agreement Details included), and writes the AI's values only into the CLM fields that are still empty: the counterparty party and Counterparty, effective and expiration dates, value (only a USD amount: CLM Value reaches Agreement Manager as USD) and Currency, renewal term (in months) and renewal notice (in days; a notice in months counts 30 days each; also as Termination Notice, as Import agreement dates does). Loop guard: its first step stops when Contract Process ▸ AI Write-back is Done, and otherwise sets Done, waits 5 minutes (a document that has just entered the folder is not in Agreement Manager yet, and Use AI Data Insights started before it is there never finishes: 2 ZZ Lab runs waited over 35 minutes) and then runs Use AI Data Insights, because that step makes Agreement Manager process the document again (an unguarded rule on Document Processed for AI Insights looped: about 1,000 runs in 33 minutes on 21 documents, 2026-11-21, nothing overwritten). It is started once per document by the smart rules in assets/clm-smart-rules/specs/fontara-iamclm-ai-write-back.json: a document entering /Contracts is marked Pending, and a chained rule that requires Pending starts this workflow. A value a person entered or reviewed is never overwritten: Edit CLM Agreement Attributes leaves a field alone when its value is empty. The run log names what was written.

WGuard.code:
// The marker as CLM holds it now: Done means a run has written back already
return Convert.ToString(GetVariableValue("DocXml.Documents.Document.ContractProcess.AIWriteback")).Trim();
